markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (73%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Flagged (Tier 2): out-of-distribution input (19% reliability) [F6] and conformal set spans Benign, InSitu, and Invasive [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 73%, Invasive 14%, Benign 13%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; 14% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%, 90% coverage) | Cannot exclude Benign or Invasive |
| Reliability / OOD | 19% reliability, 100th percentile OOD (12 tiles kept) | Flagged suspect out-of-distribution input |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent foundation models disagree |
| Similar cases | 3/5 InSitu (60%) [F5]; top 2 Invasive (86%, 84%) | Mixed; closest neighbors are Invasive |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 5, 9, 10) · context · Above typical [F2]; negative weight (-0.71) pulls away from invasive · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 4) · ↑ invasive · Below typical [F3]; scarcity pushes score toward invasive (+0.70) · Validated
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 4) · ↑ invasive · Below typical [F4]; pushes toward invasive (+0.45), unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 9) · ↓ invasive · Below-average stromal invasion score (-0.31) pulls away from invasive · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction and pleomorphism** (regions 2, 9, 11) · context · 73% neoplastic cells (97th percentile) [F7]; size variation 95th percentile [F10] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions (9, 11, 2, 1) harbor stromal invasion matching the two closest Invasive neighbors (86%, 84% similarity).
- Out-of-distribution quality distorts embeddings, or weak lymphocyte scoring masks invasion despite 0% measured immune cells [F12].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 11, 2, 1**: Inspect highest-risk foci (84%–100% risk) for stromal invasion; consider drafted p63 and calponin.
2. **Regions 2, 8, 9, 11**: Evaluate duct-confined atypia (41 µm² nuclei [F9], 2447/mm² density [F8]) with ER, CK5/6, deeper levels.
3. **Regions 5, 9, 10**: Verify true TILs versus artifact (0 immune cells counted in region 9); consider drafted H&E recut.
